about: The input packages of study 2's blind workers, built by blind.py from one lab commit. Each package is an explicit allow-list: a lab file enters only when it is named here (a folder entry takes every file Git holds under it), at its lab path. `derived` files are written by the builder from named lab files and recorded in the manifest with their sources. `considered` lists what was read and left out, with the reason.
